description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_news that implements validation logic for news (Usenet) URI scheme as specified by RFC 1738, including properties for browsability and host omission, and a method to validate and sanitize the URI object.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_news
classes.description: A class that represents the 'news' URI scheme and provides validation and properties related to this scheme.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the given URI object for the 'news' scheme by clearing userinfo, host, port, and query components, returning true to indicate the URI is valid after sanitization.
